title: Full Source Repository Verification
description: ยืนยันว่า GitHub private repository เก็บ full editable source code และไม่มี Next.js build artifacts พร้อมเพิ่มคู่มือแก้ไข/พัฒนาต่อจาก source.
scope: audit tracked files and ignore rules for build artifact exclusion
document editable source map and continuation commands
clarify that build is release validation and not a Git deliverable
verification: Git tracked-file scan finds no .next, dist, build, node_modules, coverage or TypeScript build artifacts
.gitignore excludes Next.js outputs, dependencies, coverage, environment files, uploads, exports and local data
SOURCE_CONTINUATION.md maps editable source locations and source-only development workflow
rollback: Return to tag v0.12.2-landing-interactions. This documentation-only release changes no application behavior, schema or customer data.
constraints: GitHub stores editable source, tests, documentation, schemas and release metadata; never generated build output.
No real secret, customer data, uploaded drawing, price export or environment file may enter Git history.
